clips.send: Floating and neutral suspension both mean buoyancy balances weight. A floating object sticks out of the surface, while a suspended object stays fully submerged. At the surface, the fraction of volume underwater equals the object's average density divided by the liquid density.
clips.text: Floating and neutral suspension both mean buoyancy balances weight. A floating object sticks out of the surface, while a suspended object stays fully submerged. At the surface, the fraction of volume underwater equals the object's average density divided by the liquid density.

clips.send: The model starts with a fully inflated balloon of fixed volume (2000 cubic meters ). The outside air has a density of 1.20 kg/ cubic meters . The envelope, basket and load have a combined mass of 450 kg. As some air escapes during heating, the air inside gets less dense. The balloon rises when buoyancy exceeds its total weight.
clips.text: The model starts with a fully inflated balloon of fixed volume (2000 m³). The outside air has a density of 1.20 kg/m³. The envelope, basket and load have a combined mass of 450 kg. As some air escapes during heating, the air inside gets less dense. The balloon rises when buoyancy exceeds its total weight.

clips.send: A hollow hull can displace enough water to support the ship. While afloat, displacement in mass units equals the total mass of the ship and its load. The model ship has an empty mass of 600 metric tons (1 t equals 1000 kg).
clips.text: A hollow hull can displace enough water to support the ship. While afloat, displacement in mass units equals the total mass of the ship and its load. The model ship has an empty mass of 600 metric tons (1 t = 1000 kg).

clips.send: Buoyant force (浮力, fúlì) is the upward push of a liquid or gas on an object. At rest, the scale’s pull and buoyancy together balance the block’s weight. Subtract the reading in liquid from the reading in air.
clips.text: Buoyant force (浮力, fúlì) is the upward push of a liquid or gas on an object. At rest, the scale’s pull and buoyancy together balance the block’s weight. Subtract the reading in liquid from the reading in air.

clips.send: Taking water into ballast tanks increases the submarine’s average density. Compressed air pushes water out, lowering its average density. To hover at rest, balance buoyancy and weight.
clips.text: Taking water into ballast tanks increases the submarine’s average density. Compressed air pushes water out, lowering its average density. To hover at rest, balance buoyancy and weight.

clips.send: Buoyancy equals the weight of the liquid or gas pushed aside. In the same uniform liquid, displacing more liquid gives more buoyancy. For the same displaced volume, a denser liquid gives more buoyancy.
clips.text: Buoyancy equals the weight of the liquid or gas pushed aside. In the same uniform liquid, displacing more liquid gives more buoyancy. For the same displaced volume, a denser liquid gives more buoyancy.

clips.send: Read the stem at the liquid surface after the hydrometer floats freely. Its weight stays fixed, so in a denser liquid it displaces less and floats higher. The model hydrometer has a mass of 60 g.
clips.text: Read the stem at the liquid surface after the hydrometer floats freely. Its weight stays fixed, so in a denser liquid it displaces less and floats higher. The model hydrometer has a mass of 60 g.

clips.send: 浮力等于物体排开的液体或气体所受的重力。在同一种均匀液体中，排液体积越大，浮力越大。排液体积相同时，液体密度越大，浮力也越大。
clips.text: 浮力等于物体排开的液体或气体所受的重力。在同一种均匀液体中，排液体积越大，浮力越大。排液体积相同时，液体密度越大，浮力也越大。

clips.send: 把密度计放入液体，等它自由漂浮后，在液面处读数。它的重力固定，液体密度越大，排液体积越小，密度计浮得越高。模型密度计质量为 60 g。
clips.text: 把密度计放入液体，等它自由漂浮后，在液面处读数。它的重力固定，液体密度越大，排液体积越小，密度计浮得越高。模型密度计质量为 60 g。

clips.send: 浮力是液体或气体对物体向上的托力。物块静止时，向上的拉力与浮力之和等于向下的重力。用空气中的示数减去液体中的示数，就得到浮力。
clips.text: 浮力是液体或气体对物体向上的托力。物块静止时，向上的拉力与浮力之和等于向下的重力。用空气中的示数减去液体中的示数，就得到浮力。

clips.send: 让水进入压载水舱，潜水艇的平均密度增大。用压缩空气把水排出，平均密度减小。要在水中静止悬浮，需把重力调到与浮力相等。
clips.text: 让水进入压载水舱，潜水艇的平均密度增大。用压缩空气把水排出，平均密度减小。要在水中静止悬浮，需把重力调到与浮力相等。

clips.send: 漂浮和悬浮时，浮力都等于重力。漂浮时物体露出液面一部分，悬浮时物体完全浸没。漂浮时，浸入体积占总体积的比例等于物体平均密度与液体密度之比。
clips.text: 漂浮和悬浮时，浮力都等于重力。漂浮时物体露出液面一部分，悬浮时物体完全浸没。漂浮时，浸入体积占总体积的比例等于物体平均密度与液体密度之比。

clips.send: 中空船体能排开足够多的水。轮船漂浮时，排水量是排开水的质量，等于船和所载物的总质量。模型空船质量为 600 吨（1 吨等于1000 kg）。
clips.text: 中空船体能排开足够多的水。轮船漂浮时，排水量是排开水的质量，等于船和所载物的总质量。模型空船质量为 600 吨（1 吨＝1000 kg）。

clips.send: 这个模型中，球囊已经充分膨胀，体积固定为 2000 立方米 ，周围空气密度为 1.20 kg/ 立方米 ，球囊、吊篮与载荷共 450 kg。加热时部分空气从开口流出，囊内空气密度降低。浮力超过气球的总重力时，气球上升。
